anatomy.intro: The same ribbed stem carries green working tissue and lighter variegated sectors.

parts.function: A notch beneath an areole gives the rib its characteristic chin-shaped projection.
parts.label: Chin-like rib

parts.function: This cushion bears the short, curved spine cluster.
parts.label: Areole

parts.function: Green tissue contains chlorophyll used to capture light for photosynthesis.
parts.label: Green sector

parts.function: Lighter sectors interrupt the green pattern without representing a second grafted plant.
parts.label: Variegated sector

flowers.text: Costa Farms describes creamy to pinkish flowers for this exact variegated selection, while ordinary species accounts include greener or yellow-brown blooms. The seller description is a useful expectation, but the color of a future flower on this specimen still needs an observation.

growth.note: Color pattern is not a cultivar-level identification by itself, and no offset or bloom is claimed for this specimen.

stages.text: A compact stem already displays rib notches and patches of color.
stages.title: Small globe

stages.text: Growth enlarges the globe; the exact distribution of colored sectors varies.
stages.title: Wider body

stages.text: A mature stem may produce flowers or offsets while retaining a compact habit.
stages.title: Established plant

habitat.text: The wild species occurs in rocky places in Paraguay and northeastern Argentina. This variegated nursery plant is a cultivated form, so yellow and pink sectors should not be presented as the normal appearance of every wild population. Its collection record is specifically an own-root plant, unlike the two-part grafted moon cacti often sold beside it.

Own-root variegated Gymnocalycium mihanovichii, a squat cactus globe with 8 notched ribs, green/bronze tissue and muted yellow-pink variegated sectors. lookalikes.name: Grafted neon moon cactus
lookalikes.text: A graft has a colored scion visibly joined to a separate green rootstock. This collection plant retains green tissue in its own body and is recorded on its own roots.

mature.text: Costa Farms gives about 15 cm tall or wide for its selection. This is a seller estimate for the cultivated form, not a measurement or a deadline for the collection plant.

milestones.text: Joined the collection from Costa Farms.
milestones.title: Acquired

nameStory.text: Gymnocalycium means naked calyx: its flower buds lack the spines and hairs found on many other cactus flower tubes. The name refers to flowers, not a completely spineless body.
